How to apply

Message @hokeemDeng on Telegram with:

  • what you are building and who it is for;
  • which models you plan to use and a rough monthly token estimate;
  • a link to your project, profile or past work.

We review applications on a rolling basis. Projects that share feedback or publish their results may receive additional credits.

Terms

Credits apply to Zenith Tokens usage only. Each award states its amount, the models it covers, its validity period and any rate limits. Credits have no cash value and cannot be transferred.
